# Keys you hand over - qa-automator

## Outputs

- `work/s5-notes/S5-qa-automator-*.md` - the notes of ONE automator dispatch
- `work/s5-notes/` - the S5 notes folder, one file per dispatch
- `work/s5-plan.json` - the plan for every case of S5 is the automator's decision (levels, shapes, consolidation); `s5_plan.py --init` writes only the skeleton and moves a stale plan to work/s5-plan.prev.json; a rework grows it in place; the critic and the windows only read it

Required at your stop (stage S5): `work/automation-manifest.json`.
Re-run by the gate at your stop: `s5_precheck.py`, `branch_accounting.py`.

## Witness

Your witness artifact (stages.json `witness`): `work/automation-manifest.json`.

## Handoff form

Contract `s5-automator-to-critic` (fill `work/handoffs/<dispatch>.yaml`; `handoff_check.py` reads it):

- `header.window` (required) - the case ids of this window, comma separated
- `header.verdict` (required) - one of vocabulary.header_verdicts
- `scope[].id` (required) - case or instance id
- `scope[].state` (required) - one of vocabulary.row_states
- `scope[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `scope[].origin` (required) - one of vocabulary.instance_origins - new|changed|reused
- `scope[].case_version` (required) - the pinned cv_ id this instance was written against
- `scope[].obligations` (optional) - obligation ids of the plan row this instance answers, or an empty list
- `artifacts.runtime_provenance` (required) - path of the runtime_provenance record of this window's run
- `artifacts.tests[]` (required) - repo-relative path of every test file this window wrote or changed
- `artifacts.run_witness` (required) - path of the run_suite summary with the exit code and the totals line
- `artifacts.probes[]` (optional) - work/probes/<instance>.json, one per new or changed instance, or the empty list
- `artifacts.notes` (optional) - work/s5-notes/<your dispatch id>.md, or omit
- `claims.every_case_in_scope_has_an_instance` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_instance_names_its_current_case_version` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_instance_ran` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_expectation_change_after_red_is_recorded` (required) - true|false
- `claims.manifest_matches_the_tests` (required) - true|false
- `plan_remarks[].id` (optional) - PR-n, or the empty list
- `plan_remarks[].row` (required) - one of vocabulary.plan_remark_rows
- `plan_remarks[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `deviations[].test` (optional) - file::function of the test that differs, or the empty list
- `deviations[].from` (required) - one of vocabulary.plan_deviation_kinds
- `deviations[].planned` (required) - file::function or T-n of the planned test
- `deviations[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `tried[].requirement` (required) - R-n, a source id or an area
- `tried[].technique` (required) - what you did to make the test fall (the mutation, the wrong value, the removed line)
- `tried[].observation` (required) - what you saw, in one line
- `tried[].evidence` (required) - the path (and anchor) where it shows
- `tried_note` (optional) - why the table is empty, or a dash when it has rows
- `unresolved[].id` (required) - case or instance id
- `unresolved[].reason` (required) - one of vocabulary.unresolved_reasons
- `unresolved[].detail` (required) - what exactly is missing, and what would settle it
- `unresolved[].instance_ids` (optional) - only when blocked_by_env: every instance the stand blocked, comma separated
- `unresolved[].remedy` (optional) - only when blocked_by_env: kind, where, change, restart - names only
- `for_the_reviewer[]` (required) - one line: where the risk is, what you would question, what you already proved
- `blocked.field` (only when blocked) - the field of this file the role cannot fill
- `blocked.problem` (only when blocked) - what the role tried and what refused it, verbatim
- `blocked.tried[]` (only when blocked) - command or step, and its answer
- `blocked.data[]` (only when blocked) - path of anything the conductor needs to see

Every handoff form shares one skeleton (`common_shape` of handoffs/index.yaml): `inputs`, `inputs_read`, `header`, `scope`, `artifacts`, `claims`, `unresolved`, `blocked`.
